## Decisions

- **Use admin_list_users() for querying auth user metadata**: PostgREST cannot directly query auth.users; security-definer helper exposes only safe metadata guarded by permissions.
- **Perform role and group assignments via Server Actions**: Direct user role updates run as the authenticated user, allowing RLS to enforce no-escalation rules and last-admin triggers.
